name: Lab Staff
description: Grouping role for all laboratory staff

name: Results Validator
description: Can validate and approve test results

name: Surveillance
description: Grouping role for all surveillance module users

name: Coordinator
description: Have full access to the surveillance module, receive all automated alert notifications, manage alert investigation and closure, configure surveillance settings including notifiable diseases thresholds and parameters, view and manage the surveillance dashboard, receive alert notifications (email dashboard), investigate and manage alerts, export line lists and reports, manage SKDR integration settings, view transmission logs, generate and distribute bulletins

name: Laboratory Analyst
description: Viewing surveillance priority indicators, receiving notifications for surveillance-related samples, entering and validating laboratory test results, not having permission to modify surveillance configurations or thresholds

name: Public Health
description: Read-only access to surveillance data and dashboards, receiving periodic summary bulletins, exporting surveillance data for further analysis, not being able to modify alerts configurations or system settings

name: System SKDR
description: Retrieve surveillance-related information from SKDR including field-reported indicators and alerts, transmit laboratory-confirmed surveillance data back to SKDR in standardized IBS and EBS formats, maintain synchronization logs for data exchange activities
